title: Access and Analyze Biodiversity Data from Peru's Protected Natural Areas
text: rbioanp provides convenient access curated biodiversity datasets Peru’s National System State-Protected Natural Areas (SINANPE) bioANP platform. package includes standardized datasets flora fauna species inventories occurrence records Peru’s diverse ecosystems, facilitating biodiversity research conservation analysis.

title: Access and Analyze Biodiversity Data from Peru's Protected Natural Areas
text: Peru one biodiverse countries world, vast ecosystems ranging Amazon rainforest Andes mountains coastal regions. SINANPE system protects critical areas, bioANP platform provides comprehensive biodiversity inventories. package makes valuable datasets easily accessible researchers, conservationists, data scientists using R.

title: Access and Analyze Biodiversity Data from Peru's Protected Natural Areas
text: Access official biodiversity data Peru’s protected natural areas Flora dataset: 12,052+ standardized plant species across SINANPE Fauna dataset: 6,420+ animal species (vertebrates) taxonomic classification Occurrence records: 55,155+ species occurrences within protected areas Protected areas registry: Official listing 287 state-protected natural areas legal administrative information Cleaned taxonomic data: Standardized scientific names, infraspecific ranks, taxonomic classifications

title: Access and Analyze Biodiversity Data from Peru's Protected Natural Areas
code: library(rbioanp) library(dplyr)  # Load the protected areas registry data(anp_list) head(anp_list)  # Count protected areas by category table(anp_list$categoria)  # Load fauna species data data(anp_species_fauna)  # Count species by group anp_species_fauna %>%   group_by(grupo) %>%   tally()  # Load occurrence records data(anp_species_occ)  # Find endemic threatened species anp_species_occ %>%   filter(endemica == TRUE, amenazada == TRUE)  # Species distribution across protected areas anp_species_occ %>%   count(anp_nombre, sort = TRUE)

title: Official List of State-Protected Natural Areas in Peru — anp_list
Official List of State-Protected Natural Areas in Peru — anp_list
text: tibble 287 rows 13 variables: categoria Character. Category protected area (e.g., "PARQUES NACIONALES", "RESERVAS NACIONALES", "SANTUARIOS NACIONALES"). Represents IUCN management category adapted Peruvian legislation. codigo Character. Primary identification code protected area, typically consisting category abbreviation sequential number (e.g., "PN 01" first National Park). nombre Character. Official name protected area. codigo_2 Character. Secondary identification code, applicable. Contains NA entries. nombre_2 Character. Secondary alternative name, applicable. Contains NA entries. base_legal_creacion Character. Legal instrument established protected area (e.g., "LEY 13694", "D.S. 644-1973-AG"). May include laws (LEY), supreme decrees (D.S.), legal documents. fecha_promulgacion_creacion Date. Promulgation date legal instrument created protected area, YYYY-MM-DD format. base_legal_modificacion Character. Legal instrument(s) modified original protected area designation, . May contain multiple references separated semicolons. Contains NA modifications exist. fecha_promulgacion_modificacion Character. Promulgation date(s) modification legal instruments. May contain multiple dates separated slashes multiple modifications. Contains NA modifications exist. ubicación_politica Character. Political-administrative location protected area, listing department(s) located. Multiple departments separated commas "y" (). extension_ha Numeric. Total area protected area hectares. fuente Character. Data source, typically "SERNANP" (Servicio Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas por el Estado). version Character. Version date official list DD-MM-YYYY format.

title: Official List of State-Protected Natural Areas in Peru — anp_list
text: dataset includes categories state-protected natural areas Peru: National Parks (Parques Nacionales - PN) National Sanctuaries (Santuarios Nacionales - SN) Historical Sanctuaries (Santuarios Históricos - SH) National Reserves (Reservas Nacionales - RN) Wildlife Refuges (Refugio de Vida Silvestre - RVS) Landscape Reserves (Reservas Paisajísticas - RP) Communal Reserves (Reservas Comunales - RC) Protection Forests (Bosques de Protección - BP) Hunting Reserves (Cotos de Caza - CC) Reserved Zones (Zonas Reservadas - ZR) Regional Conservation Areas (Áreas de Conservación Regional - ACR) Private Conservation Areas (Áreas de Conservación Privada - ACP) protected areas system Peru covers various ecosystems including Amazon rainforest, Andean highlands, coastal deserts, marine environments. dataset reflects official status version date specified version variable. Legal instruments referenced include: LEY: Law passed Congress D.S.: Decreto Supremo (Supreme Decree) R.M.: Resolución Ministerial (Ministerial Resolution) D.L.: Decreto Ley (Decree Law)

title: Official List of State-Protected Natural Areas in Peru — anp_list
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Load the dataset data(anp_list)  # View the first few entries head(anp_list)  # Count protected areas by category table(anp_list$categoria)  # Find the largest protected area anp_list[which.max(anp_list$extension_ha), ]  # List all National Parks subset(anp_list, categoria == "PARQUES NACIONALES")  # Protected areas created after 2000 subset(anp_list, fecha_promulgacion_creacion > as.Date("2000-01-01"))  # Total protected area (hectares) by category aggregate(extension_ha ~ categoria, data = anp_list, FUN = sum)  } # }
